summary: Rather than treating artificial intelligence like a novelty, entrepreneurs must **put technology to work by targeting major operational bottlenecks** to successfully scale an enterprise. By leveraging AI to **automate crucial revenue-generating functions** such as prospect qualification, personalized pitching, and customer follow-up, businesses can eliminate human burnout and dramatically multiply their overall output. Furthermore, founders can **implement the ten-eighty-ten framework**—collaborating on initial ideation, letting technology handle the heavy lifting of execution, and applying a final personal touch—to delegate the majority of daily tasks. Ultimately, the true purpose of this approach is to **systematically replace yourself with automation** before market competitors do, freeing up valuable time to focus strictly on high-level strategy.
